events.title: TransDigm's Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Sales Increase Y/Y
events.body: TDG beats Q2 estimates with strong sales growth and raises full-year guidance, but rising interest expenses and debt levels add pressure.

events.title: TXT Q1 Deep Dive: Industrial Separation and Aerospace-Defense Focus Take Center Stage
events.body: Aerospace and defense company Textron (NYSE:TXT) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 11.8% year on year to $3.70 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.45 per share was 11.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
